description.value: Green Timbers Pub is a well-established neighbourhood sports bar and full-service restaurant in Surrey, anchored by big-screen TVs for Canucks, Lions, and NFL/NHL viewing. The venue is also home to one of the largest BC Lottery Centres in the province and an attached full-service liquor store. A touring cyclist seeking a casual sit-down meal or cold drink in the Green Timbers area would find this a lively, familiar local stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the name, address, and phone number matching OSM tags; the site describes a sports bar, restaurant, lottery centre, and liquor store in Surrey, BC. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, leaving all amenity fields null. One minor inconsistency: the website front-page header reads 'Langely, British Columbia' despite the address being clearly in Surrey, and the about subpage lists a .ca email while other pages use .com.
